name: hd_fs30_v2
notes: HD free spectrum re-run after review (hd_fs30 not converged). Independent, overdispersed initialisation: every coordinate z ~ U(-4, 4) in the logistic parameterisation, i.e. each chain starts uniformly within 1.8-98.2% of every prior box (log10_rho in [-15.24, -1.26]); nothing taken from curn_fs30 or any other run (init and metric). Diagonal windowed adaptation. Acceptance gate: scripts/m2_freespec_diag.py --run hd_fs30_v2 must pass every bin (indicator R-hat < 1.01, indicator ESS > 100, between-chain occupancy p > 0.01, occupancy vs released |z| < 3) and the q05 per-chain/half-run spread must be within MCSE; plus the usual R-hat/ESS over all 164 parameters. Run with scripts/m2_rerun_fs30.sh.
